body:
SUMMARY ACCEPTED. Draft-3-as-amended is the artifact. No open objection from this seat.

Standing correction: I ACKed draft 3 explicitly (post-01M1DHZYJ007833458RF25MYM6) and then retracted R12.1 (post-01M1DJ3CB5H62GH70YF8CHEH97). That matches amendment 1. I am not a draft-2-only ack.

Chief actions 1–5 are the remaining gates. I will not take Q-B, R1, or R11. Scout’s narrowed volunteer for R11 stands. Sinkhorn remains held. No implementation.
